note: Eight Blue Ocean niche profiles for the Local Niche Opportunity Scorer + Local Marketing Opportunity Brief. Names describe the WEALTH TRANSITION, not demographics — that is what makes a niche ownable. Salesforce field mapping intentionally omitted: as of 2026-06-11 these are NOT in Salesforce, so there is no Segment_Tag__c picklist to reconcile against yet. When the field is created, the Salesforce picklist becomes canonical and this list must mirror it exactly.
